# _Resources_ for The Swift AI address structuring model

Please note this is not a standalone repository. It bundles the resources needed for [The Swift AI address structuring model](https://github.com/Swift-SC/iso20022-address-structuring) to run.

Since some of these resources include, are based off, or are derived from, other open-source data sets, they are separately distributed.

Please refer to the LICENSE, NOTICES and the documentation of the [main repository](https://github.com/Swift-SC/iso20022-address-structuring) for more details.
